style.styleTitle: Homcom 4ft Pre-Lit Snow Flocked Christmas Tree
style.toneOfVoice: Bring a snowy winter forest feel indoors with this pre-lit flocked Christmas tree. Featuring a realistic spruce design with PE and PVC tips, it creates a natural festive look while saving space. The 160 warm white LEDs offer 8 lighting modes, controlled by the included remote or controller. Finished with a glowing white pot base and fire-retardant flocking, it adds a charming touch to your Christmas decor. . Realistic snow-flocked spruce design creates a beautiful winter woodland atmosphere; . Realistic PE tips are paired with inner PVC tips, creating an exceptionally realistic, full and thick holiday tree; . Pre-lit with 160 warm white LED lights for a cosy festive glow; . 8 lighting modes offer a variety of flashing and steady light effects; . Remote control included for convenient lighting adjustment from a distance; . Includes a CR2025 battery for the remote control; . The white plastic pot base allows light to shine through for a magical effect; . Fire-retardant PVC tips and flocking provide added safety for seasonal use; . Compact 4ft size is suitable for apartments, bedrooms, hallways and smaller spaces; . Quick 10-15 minute assembly with simple manual tip adjustment. . Colour: Green, White; . Light Colour: Warm White; . Material: PE, PVC, Steel, Plastic; . Overall Dimensions: F90 x 120H cm; . Base Dimensions: F18.5 x 26H cm; . Tip Count: 200; . LED Light Count: 160; . Lighting Modes: 8; . Remote Battery: CR2025 (included); . Adapter Input: 220-240V, 0.1A; . Adapter Output: DC 31V, 0.12A, 3.6W; . Item Label: 83C-334V71GN; . Shaping Note: Approx. 10-15 minutes of manual tip shaping recommended to achieve maximum natural fullness.
